markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (58%)** · Ambiguous: Benign vs InSitu · Careful review
InSitu (37%) stays in the 90% conformal set on this resampled frozen section; invasive risk is 3% [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 58%, InSitu 37%, Invasive 3%, Normal 2% | Benign leads; InSitu remains plausible |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (alpha 0.10, 90% coverage) | Cannot separate Benign from InSitu |
| Reliability / OOD | 96% reliability, 100% OOD, 12 tiles [F6] | Passes QC despite severity-3 resampling |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree | Independent models match top class |
| Similar cases | 2/5 Benign (40%), 3/5 Normal [F5] | Mixed Benign and Normal neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical (-0.41, contrib -0.87) opposes invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 5) · ↓ invasive · Below-typical (-0.30, contrib -0.33); unreliable 0/20 check [F3] · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 6) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical (+0.10, contrib +0.25) nudges toward invasion [F4] · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top 3 risk regions drops P(invasive) above random (+0.011, 95% CI +0.002 to +0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unvalidated (deletion CI -0.009 to +0.006 includes 0); uses unreliable mitoses (0/20) and normal lobules (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Severity-3 frozen-section resampling masks InSitu carcinoma (37% probability); deeper levels are drafted while stains are blocked.
- Sub-threshold margin signals (lateral 97%, medial 97%, inferior 81%) reflect true involvement despite the clear call [F7].

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 11**: Highest tile risk (5%, 3%) and pleomorphism (+0.54 in region 11); exclude invasion.
2. **Regions 6, 5**: Check duct-confined atypia (region 6) and lymphocytes (region 5) for Benign vs InSitu.
3. **Regions 4, 8, 11**: Inspect medial (97%) and lateral (97%) margins; consider drafted deeper levels.
